استأنيت (form X)
# اِسْتَأْنَيْتُ (istaʔnaytu) /is.taʔ.naj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَأْنَى (istaʔnā)
# اِسْتَأْنَيْتَ (istaʔnayta) /is.taʔ.naj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَأْنَى (istaʔnā)
# اِسْتَأْنَيْتِ (istaʔnayti) /is.taʔ.naj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَأْنَى (istaʔnā)
